name: @domusafe/web
description: DomuSafe installable web app. Later modules reuse this shell, its tokens and its components.

scripts.build: paraglide-js compile --project ./project.inlang --outdir ./src/paraglide --strategy localStorage baseLocale --emit-ts-declarations && vite build && node scripts/check-shell-budget.mjs
scripts.typecheck: paraglide-js compile --project ./project.inlang --outdir ./src/paraglide --strategy localStorage baseLocale --emit-ts-declarations && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json --noEmit
scripts.test: paraglide-js compile --project ./project.inlang --outdir ./src/paraglide --strategy localStorage baseLocale --emit-ts-declarations && vitest run
scripts.api:check: openapi-typescript ../api/openapi.json -o src/lib/api.generated.check.ts && diff -q src/lib/api.generated.ts src/lib/api.generated.check.ts; status=$?; rm -f src/lib/api.generated.check.ts; exit $status
